description: Government collection: official circulars vs impersonation fraud.

samples.message: Public notice: Municipal Corporation water maintenance on Sunday. Citizens are advised to store water. Toll free helpline 1800-11-2929.
Your ITR for AY 2026-27 has been processed. Refund of Rs.8,400 credited to your bank account. - Income Tax Department
Voter list verification camp at Community Hall on Saturday 10 AM. Carry Aadhaar for enrollment. - Election Office
Property tax deadline extended to 31st October as per government order 482/2026. Pay on the municipal portal.
INCOME TAX ALERT: Your PAN will be deactivated today! Pay Rs.5,000 penalty via the link or face arrest by the CBI.
This is Cyber Crime Officer Sharma. A case is filed against your Aadhaar. Pay Rs.20,000 settlement now over call to close it.
Aadhaar update required urgently. Your biometrics are locked. Share OTP sent to your mobile to unlock within 1 hour.
EPFO interest for FY 2025-26 credited to your PF account. Check passbook on the member portal. - EPFO
Subsidy of Rs.2,000 under the farmer scheme approved. Give your bank details and OTP on call to receive it today.
Passport appointment confirmed for 22nd September, 11 AM at PSK Noida. Carry originals and application receipt.
